note: Seed lexicon (Stage-1 scaffold). severity: high = fails the lint gate; medium = review. The main register control for Japanese is STRUCTURAL (sentence-final です/ます system — see policy rule 1); this lexicon covers vocabulary-level offenders.

offenders.reason: confrontational 'you' — real Japanese uses name+さん or omits
marked 'you' (superior-to-junior) — use name+さん or omit
rough casual male 'I' — starter register is 私
casual/male 'I' — starter models 私; acceptable only if a later node teaches pronoun range
textbook 'you' that natives avoid — omit or use name+さん; never model as conversational address
casual contraction — deferred to the casual-speech node
slang — fine at the casual-speech node, not before
